FEEDBACK_PAIR.rule: 384 eligible train and 384 eligible sealed tasks; >=5pp over strongest registered control, positive simultaneous clustered intervals and all-failure gain, and <=103% actual generation token cost.

BUDGET_RLVR_PAIRED_PILOT.rule: 2048 complete rows, late rescue >= 5%, expected rollout token ratio <= 1.03, and RMSE at least 20% lower than the strongest comparator.

DECISION_CHECK_B0.rule: At least 100 qualified replayable training games, at least 3 types with 10 each, and 200 isolated heldout games.

CONTINUAL_RLVR.rule: C1 A +5pp, B initial pass@16 >= 20%, B loses 5pp with repeat agreement. C2 equal-budget stage-B +3pp, both seeds positive, A loss <= 1.5pp, cost and proxy gates.

P2.rule: A3(NCP)-A3(DrZero) >= 0.020 and A3(NCP)-A3(Beta) >= 0.010 and A3(NCP) >= A2(NCP); needs P0 PASS and P1 GO

AMP_GAP_P0A.rule: 1,000 MATH train problems (200/level), 8 samples per arm; GO if some high-budget arm and tau in {0.75,0.875} has >=100 confident problems at >=0.90 modal accuracy, a gap set (A_short<=0.5, A_high>=tau) of >=30 problems and >=10% share with >=0.85 accuracy and >=10pp over the R-Zero band (0.25<=A_short<=0.75), and infra<=1%.
